definitions.gloss: must arrive by; required arrival by a deadline
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a document, application, or item must physically arrive at the destination by a specified date. Contrasts with {消印有効|けしいんゆうこう}, where the postmark date counts.

examples.japanese: {応募|おうぼ}は{十月|じゅうがつ}{三十一日|さんじゅういちにち}{必着|ひっちゃく}です。
{書類|しょるい}は{金曜日|きんようび}{必着|ひっちゃく}でお{送|おく}りください。
examples.english: Please send the documents so they arrive by Friday.

examples.japanese: {必着|ひっちゃく}の{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}うよう、{速達|そくたつ}で{送|おく}った。
examples.english: I sent it by express mail to make the must-arrive deadline.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {必|ひっ} (must, certainly) and {着|ちゃく} (arrival). Very common in application deadlines for jobs, contests, government forms, and university admissions. Always used with a date to specify when the item must arrive.

IMPORTANT CONTRAST:
- {必着|ひっちゃく}: the item must physically arrive by the date
- {消印有効|けしいんゆうこう}: valid if postmarked by the date — more lenient, as only the mailing date matters

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜{日|にち}{必着|ひっちゃく} (must arrive by ~ date)
- {必着|ひっちゃく}で{送|おく}る (to send for required arrival)
- {必着|ひっちゃく}の{締|し}め{切|き}り (a must-arrive deadline)
